title: Automated Design of Agentic Systems
authors: Shengran Hu; Cong Lu; Jeff Clune

problem_statement.en: Building blocks of agentic systems (chain-of-thought, self-reflection, tool use, memory) and their combination into effective compound workflows are still hand-designed, requiring substantial domain-specific manual tuning by researchers and engineers. The paper introduces and formalizes the problem of Automated Design of Agentic Systems (ADAS): whether the design of agentic systems — inventing novel building blocks and combining them — can itself be automated.
problem_statement.zh: agentic 系統的基本構件(chain-of-thought、self-reflection、tool use、memory)及其組合為有效複合 workflow 的方式,目前仍仰賴人工設計,需要研究人員與工程師投入大量特定領域的手動調校。本文提出並形式化 Automated Design of Agentic Systems(ADAS)問題:agentic 系統的設計——包含發明新的基本構件並加以組合——本身是否能夠被自動化。

key_innovation.en: Meta Agent Search: a frozen "meta" LLM agent (GPT-4) iteratively programs new agentic systems as executable Python code (a `forward` function within a ~100-line framework), each new design conditioned on an ever-growing archive of previously discovered agents and their measured validation performance. Because programming languages are Turing-complete, searching the code space can in principle express any agent — arbitrary prompts, tool use, control flow, and their combinations — going beyond prior prompt-only or fixed-graph search spaces.
key_innovation.zh: Meta Agent Search:採用一個凍結參數的「meta」LLM agent(GPT-4),迭代地將新的 agentic 系統編寫為可執行的 Python 程式碼(於約 100 行框架內的 `forward` 函式),每一個新設計皆以持續擴增的歷史檔案為條件,該檔案記錄先前發現的 agent 及其在驗證集上實測的效能表現。由於程式語言具備 Turing-complete 特性,搜尋程式碼空間原則上可表達任意 agent——任意 prompt、tool use、控制流程及其組合——從而超越先前僅限 prompt 或固定 graph 的搜尋空間。

baselines_compared: Chain-of-Thought, Self-Consistency with CoT, Self-Refine, LLM-Debate, Quality-Diversity, Step-back Abstraction, Role Assignment, Prompt Optimization

key_improvements.en: DROP F1 79.4 vs 65.8 best hand-designed; MGSM +14.4%; MGSM-searched agents transfer +25.9% to GSM8K.
key_improvements.zh: DROP F1 79.4 對最佳人工設計 65.8;MGSM +14.4%;MGSM 搜出的 agent 遷移到 GSM8K +25.9%。

decision_mechanism: Evolutionary / swarm search, Textual gradient (LLM feedback)
optimization_signal: Validation-set score, Task utility (accuracy), Textual feedback
backbone_models: GPT-4 (meta agent that programs new agents)
GPT-3.5 (execution of discovered agents and baselines / evaluation)
benchmarks_used: ARC, DROP, MGSM, MMLU, GPQA, GSM8K, GSM-Hard

agent_scenario.en: Two roles. (1) A single meta agent (GPT-4) that, during an offline search, writes the code for new candidate agentic systems and self-reflects to debug/ensure novelty. (2) The discovered agentic systems themselves, which are compound multi-call workflows executed with GPT-3.5 — e.g., a "Multi-step Peer Review Agent," a "Divide and Conquer Agent," and the best ARC agent, a "Structured Feedback and Ensemble Agent" that runs 5 chain-of-thoughts, routes answers through specialized expert roles (Efficiency Expert, Readability Expert, Simplicity Expert) plus a human-like critic, iterates a refinement loop 3 times, and finally ensembles the top-3 answers. Tools include code execution (for ARC the agent writes and runs the transformation rule rather than answering directly). Search is single-domain (run independently per domain); the framework itself (~100 lines) exposes FM-query and prompt-formatting primitives.
agent_scenario.zh: 兩種角色。(1)單一 meta agent(GPT-4),於離線搜尋過程中為新的候選 agentic 系統編寫程式碼,並透過 self-reflection 進行除錯與確保新穎性。(2)被發現的 agentic 系統本身,為以 GPT-3.5 執行的複合多次呼叫 workflow——例如「Multi-step Peer Review Agent」、「Divide and Conquer Agent」,以及最佳 ARC agent「Structured Feedback and Ensemble Agent」,後者執行 5 條 chain-of-thought,將答案經由專門的專家角色(Efficiency Expert、Readability Expert、Simplicity Expert)及一位擬人化評論者進行路由,將 refinement 迴圈迭代 3 次,最終集成前 3 名答案。工具包含程式碼執行(於 ARC 中,agent 編寫並執行轉換規則,而非直接作答)。搜尋為單一領域(各領域獨立執行);框架本身(約 100 行)提供 FM-query 與 prompt 格式化的基本原語。
